note: Extras das abas pds/fleet/mc (botões) + connector de clique. Reaplicar via boardstate_* após reset do app. Atualizado 05/10/2026 (workspace v79).

props.template: PD Studio — executa o sync ({{modo}}) via connector pd.
Fleet — executa a captura ({{modo}}) via connector pd.
Mission Control — publica o plano da missão {{missao}}.

connector.server: scripts/board_connector.py (stdio MCP mínimo, stdlib puro, sem deps)
connector.grant: capabilitiesRegistry.pd no workspace — grantedBy=user, autoConfirm nos 3 (clique roda direto)
connector.flow: widget action-form mode:tool → dashboard.action.invoke → gateCall(autoConfirm) → broker → script PD → result no widget

pitfalls: action-form mode:prompt (default) NÃO funciona neste deployment: RPC chat.send não registrada no sidecar (spawn dashboard sem options.chat). Sintoma: clique silencioso. Usar SEMPRE mode:tool + connector.
RPCs dashboard.action.* só existem com connectors wired (connectors.json presente no boot do sidecar).

Sidecar: spawned_by=dashboard, owner=hermes-serve; record em ~/.hermes/boardstate-state/.boardstate-sidecar.json (port+nonce — app lê daqui). Se o Board cair, fechar/reabrir a aba (app/serve respawna).

Grant novo: boardstate_tool_search(mode:request) → approve via POST /operator?nonce=<operator secret> {method:dashboard.capability.approve, params:{name, decision:'granted', tools, autoConfirm, actor:'user'}}.
action-form exige fields 1-8 (vazio rejeitado); tool-mode exige connector/tool/argsFrom.
Verificar com boardstate_workspace_get após reaplicar; strings estáticas <=500 chars.
